name: Tsumi naru Rasen no Ori -Whispers of Iscariot-
original_name: 罪ナル螺旋ノ檻 -Whispers of Iscariot-
source:
It's the year 1895 in the kingdom of Cusrutonia.

Atop a hill on the outskirts of a town a short distance from the capital, bells mourning the dead are resounding through the air--

They ring for the funeral of an aristocrat who was once known as this land's hero.

Whoever he was, it has nothing to do with me; for the world I live in is completely separate from that of nobles. My life will never have anything to do with them, for all eternity.

Nobles are nobles; servants are servants. 

That fact will never change.

And from here on out, I will continue to live my life at the bottom, being used by someone else.

----That was what I had always believed...until then...

Having been raised and grown up with an empty life in an orphanage, Nico has tasted nothing but hardship in his life.　Unable even to find respectable employment due to the discrimination against his half Yaff blood, he had given up on everything and fallen into despair.  Nico was doing hard labor at an undertaker's when one day, at a noble's funeral services, he was suddenly spoken to by Claus, the head of that noble's family...and from that day forth, Nico's fate was entirely changed.
translation:
这是1895年，库斯鲁尼亚王国。

距离首都不远的小镇郊外的一座小山上，哀悼死者的钟声在空中响起——

他们为一位曾经被誉为这片土地英雄的贵族举行葬礼。

不管他是谁，都与我无关；因为我生活的世界和贵族的世界是完全分开的。我的生命永远不会与他们有任何关系。

贵族就是贵族；仆人就是仆人。

这个事实永远不会改变。

从此以后，我将继续过着底层的生活，被别人利用。

----那是我一直相信的……直到那时……

尼科在孤儿院空虚的生活中长大，尝尽了生活的艰辛。　由于混血雅夫血统的歧视，他连体面的工作都找不到，他放弃了一切，陷入了绝望。尼科正在殡仪馆做苦工，有一天，在一个贵族的葬礼上，贵族一家之主克劳斯突然对他说话……从那天起，尼科的命运彻底改变了。
